basic_info.description: Welcome to 592 5th Avenue! This gorgeoous, sunny tenant-occupied upper unit has been well cared for and thoughtfully improved over the years. Currently rented month-to-month for $5016.80, this top-floor flat with its huge finished attic presents a wonderful opportunity for an investor or owner-occupant. One car parking & storage in the garage, plus a tranquil rear garden in a coveted Inner Richmond location is a great find at this price point. This is for the upper unit only with one parking space & storage. The lower unit, 590 5th Avenue, is owner occupied.
